task_summary: Implement the merge behavior in solution.py, add unittest regression coverage in public tests, and document design decisions and the verification command in HANDOFF.md.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace.
Edit solution.py and public tests; HANDOFF.md is an allowed output.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Do not access parent repositories or external services.
Return the union of keys, adding counts for shared keys; preserve zero and negative totals; do not change either input.
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
No algorithmic complexity constraint is imposed.
test_solution.py must contain at least 3 passing unittest test methods exercising the public API.

success_criteria.description: solution.py provides a type-hinted implementation that returns the union of keys, sums values for shared keys, preserves zero and negative totals, and leaves both inputs unchanged.

check.rubric: Read solution.py and assess whether its visible implementation has type hints, returns the union of keys, adds values for shared keys, preserves zero and negative totals, and avoids mutating either input collection.

success_criteria.description: test_solution.py contains at least three unittest test methods that exercise the public API and cover the requested merge behavior.

success_criteria.description: HANDOFF.md records design decisions and the verification command.
